items.title: Pullback along a morphism with surjective flat source is faithful on descent data
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file descent.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: For a morphism f: X to X' over S with X surjective and flat over S, the lemma shows that the pullback functor on descent data from X' over S to X over S is faithful (statement lines 8914-8921). The proof factors the morphism through the fibre product of X with X' over S, uses that the first factor has a section and hence induces an equivalence of the categories of descent data, and that the second factor is surjective and flat and hence induces a faithful functor (proof lines 8923-8929). The claim is H2: the same factorization device as the fpqc case, with each factor routed to the statement that applies to it, and both routings stated by the author.
